title: Composition of ring maps essentially of finite type
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to A$ and $\psi:A\to B$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings, both essentially of finite type [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra] (each target isomorphic, as an algebra over the source, to a localization $W^{-1}C$ of a finite type algebra $C$ at a multiplicative subset $W\subseteq C$). Then the composite $\psi\circ\varphi:R\to B$ is essentially of finite type.
